title: fix(studio): read the engine registration verdict on a flow, so a refused flow no longer reads as unpublished or enabled
body:
Fixes #12349
Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured correction of the claim's `no`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` gains `MetadataClient.listResponse` and the exported type `MetadataListAnswer`. Nothing is removed or retyped; `@object-ui/app-shell`'s exports are unchanged (`FlowStatusDot`, `flow-problems` are not exported from its index).

## What changes

A flow the automation engine refused at boot no longer reads "Unpublished draft" in the flow header or nothing in the Automations rail. Studio reads the engine's verdict that objectstack PR #23358 serves beside the flow list's items (`registrations`, keyed by name, `FlowRegistrationSchema`, in the installed `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1):

| verdict | rail | header Status pill |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `refused` | amber "Refused by the engine", title = `reason.message` as sent | same |
| `unregistered` | grey "Not running here" (existing label), title = new row `engine.studio.auto.unregisteredTitle` | same |
| `registered` | as today (the `_status` row decides) | as today |
| absent | as today | as today |

- `deriveFlowRunStatus` takes the verdict as a third argument; `refused` and `unregistered` decide, `registered` and absence leave the two-argument reading. Absence is never read as `registered`.
- The stored `status` is never rewritten, and `reason.message` is never parsed (a pin feeds it a message made of status words and the reading does not move).
- `FlowRegistrationContext` hands the open flow's verdict to `FlowPreview`, beside the existing `FlowRuntimeContext`.
- New strings in en and zh: `engine.studio.auto.refused`, `engine.studio.auto.unregisteredTitle`.

## Where the verdict is read, and why there

No existing Studio read carried it: `MetadataClient.list` returned `items` only, and `get` unwraps the item envelope (the open flow is read through the draft read and `/layers` anyway, neither of which carries `registration`). The smallest place is the flow list the rail already makes: `MetadataClient.listResponse` is that same read returning `{ items, registrations? }`, each verdict parsed with the spec's `FlowRegistrationSchema` (an entry that does not parse is left unjudged, which is what absence means). `list` is now `listResponse(...).items`, under the same in-flight share key, so the rail's `list` and the pillar's `listResponse` send one request. The answer type is derived from the spec's `GetMetaItemsResponse` (`Pick` of `registrations`), not restated.

A failed verdict read leaves every flow unjudged (today's reading); the rail's own list read still reports a failing list.

## Tests

At `23145e359`:
- `flow-problems.runStatus-12349.test.ts`: one pin per verdict plus absence, verdicts built with `FlowRegistrationSchema.parse`.
- `FlowStatusDot.registration-12349.test.tsx`: the rail chip per verdict plus absence.
- `StudioDesignSurface.flowRegistration-12349.test.tsx`: the real `AutomationsPillar` and `FlowPreview`, one flow per verdict plus one with none; asserts nothing is saved.
- `metadata-client.listRegistrations-12349.test.ts`: verdicts served, absence kept absent, malformed entries left unjudged, one shared request with `list`.
- Targeted run (the four above, the `runStatus-11779` pin, `FlowStatusDot.test.tsx`, `flowStatusTruth-11779`, `metadata-client.test.ts`, `inflightShare-11797`): 9 files, 83 tests passed. Full `packages/data-objectstack/`: 90 files, 1146 tests passed.
- Reverse check (committed first, restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards): removing the two verdict lines from `deriveFlowRunStatus` turns the 12349 derivation and pillar pins red (9 failed, 3 passed: the registered and absence pins stay green, as they should).
- `type-check` for app-shell and data-objectstack after the closure build (28 tasks): exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 10 changed files: 5 errors and 150 warnings, the same 5 errors (different lines) and the same 150 warnings as the 6 changed source files at `28fb2a001`; the 4 new test files add none. Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- Gate battery (phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, new-line-citations, changeset-fixed, changeset-presence): all exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 as on main (objectui#12334).
- NOT MEASURED locally: the other app-shell tests that render the Automations pillar or `FlowPreview` (45 files). The shared verify lock was held by one full `packages/app-shell/` run for over 36 minutes; declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The Problems panel's run note still shows only `not-running`; a refused flow's reason shows in the header pill and the rail, not as a panel note. Carrier: none.
- Setup's Packaged automations page (`packagedFlows.ts`) builds its rows from `_status`, so a refused packaged flow is not listed there at all, by that file's own documented design. Read-only observation, not exercised in a running app. Carrier: none.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12349-flow-registration-verdict.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch (its exports are unchanged), `@object-ui/data-objectstack` minor (the widened client surface named on the second line).
